name: @repo/service-kit
description: Edura service kit -- the host-generic half of a Bun + Hono API service (app factory, request id, client-IP trust, Next-route adapter and mount, set-cookie sink, after scheduler, Sentry binding, boot checks, route generator, parity harness core). apps/api and apps/admin-api both build on it; nothing here knows which auth instance or route table a service has.
